create_intent_slot_model_from_config: create an IntentSlotModel instance from a config object and tensorizers using the from_config classmethod
create_embedding_for_intent_slot_model: create a word embedding list from config and tensorizers using the create_embedding classmethod
arrange_model_inputs_for_joint_model: arrange tensor dict inputs by extracting tokens and sequence lengths for the joint model
arrange_targets_for_intent_slot_model: arrange target tensors by extracting doc labels and word labels from the tensor dict
export_intent_slot_model_to_caffe2: export the IntentSlotModel to Caffe2 format with optional ONNX path using caffe2_export
